metadata.question: Was nighttime light intensity lower on March 24, 2019, compared to March 9, 2019, in Beira and Manga, Mozambique?

data.raw_code: The question is about comparing nighttime light intensity between two specific dates (March 9, 2019 vs March 24, 2019) in two locations in Mozambique (Beira and Manga). 1. Data Collection: I should use VIIRS nighttime lights data (VNP46A2 or VNP46A1) which provides daily nighttime light data. The collection is "NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG" or "NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMCFG" for monthly data, but for daily I should use "NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG" or check for daily collections. 2. Location: Beira and Manga are cities in Mozambique. I'll create points for both locations and combine them. 3. Dates: March 9, 2019 and March 24, 2019. 4. Processing: Get the average radiance values for each date at both locations and compare them. 5. Validation: Check if images exist for both dates, if there are valid pixels after masking, and if the calculations are valid. For VIIRS data, I should use the 'avg_rad' band which represents the average radiance. Let me structure the code: - Define geometries for Beira and Manga - Get VIIRS images for both dates - Check if collections have data - Extract radiance values - Compare and determine answer ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const beira = ee.Geometry.Point([34.8386, -19.8333]); // Beira, Mozambique const manga = ee.Geometry.Point([35.3833, -15.0333]); // Manga, Mozambique const locations = ee.FeatureCollection([ee.Feature(beira), ee.Feature(manga)]); const date1 = '2019-03-09'; const date2 = '2019-03-24'; // 2. Data Acquisition - VIIRS Nighttime Lights const col1 = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMCFG') .filterDate(date1, ee.Date(date1).advance(1, 'day')) .select('avg_rad'); const col2 = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMCFG') .filterDate(date2, ee.Date(date2).advance(1, 'day')) .select('avg_rad'); // Check if collections have data const size1 = col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`March 9 Images: ${size1}, March 24 Images: ${size2}`); if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Get first image from each collection const img1 = col1.first(); const img2 = col2.first(); // 3. Processing - Extract radiance values const stats1 = img1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: locations, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const stats2 = img2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: locations, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const rad1 = stats1.get('avg_rad').getInfo(); const rad2 = stats2.get('avg_rad').getInfo(); // Check for valid pixels const count1 = img1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: locations, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('avg_rad').getInfo(); const count2 = img2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: locations, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('avg_rad').getInfo(); console.log(`March 9 Radiance: ${rad1?.toFixed(4)}, Pixels: ${count1}`); console.log(`March 24 Radiance: ${rad2?.toFixed(4)}, Pixels: ${count2}`); // 4. Validation & Final Answer if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } if (rad1 === null || rad2 === null || isNaN(rad1) || isNaN(rad2)) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Compare radiance values - lower on March 24 means rad2 < rad1 if (rad2 < rad1) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
